body:
## What's new in 0.1.30

### Better pictures
- **Every model now gets the words it was made for.** Each model's own quality words (like *masterpiece, best quality* for Animagine, or *score_9* for Pony) and its recommended negative prompt are added around your prompt. Your text is kept exactly as you wrote it. Pictures follow the prompt better and look sharper on about 65 models.
- **"Improve prompt" now uses a small AI helper on your computer.** It writes tags for anime and Pony models, and adds a fitting scene (setting, camera angle, light, mood) for other models, without changing what you asked for. Prompts in other languages are translated into English first; check the text before you generate. The helper downloads once (3 GB) the first time you use it, and works offline after that.

### Easier to use
- **"Best for your computer"**: the Models page shows the models that run well on your computer first.
- **"Report problem"** on every error and in Settings: opens a problem report you can check and send. User names, prompts and tokens are hidden.

### Privacy
- The letter avatar is now drawn on your computer (your email address is no longer sent to an avatar service).
- Prompts are never sent to another image service.
- Privacy policy: https://github.com/Ordryth/imagica-releases/blob/main/PRIVACY.md

### Windows
- Imagica is getting ready for the Microsoft Store (installs from the Store show no warning and are updated by the Store).

Intel Macs aren't supported: on-device AI needs a Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer).
